dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped rings on the upper-left dorsal region featuring sharp transitions from high-intensity white outer perimeters to dark gray interiors; perimeters exhibit slightly irregular, scalloped geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters on the anterior dorsal section; concentration is highest near the left edge, with blobs becoming smaller and more dispersed towards the center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper-left quadrant form an obtuse triangle, while a sequence of four smaller high-intensity blobs creates a roughly linear arrangement along the upper dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-intensity, hook-shaped mark with jagged edges is visible on the lower-mid lateral flank, lacking the internal gradient of surrounding macro-annuli.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive reticulated network of low-intensity light gray lines forming a honeycomb-like pattern across the posterior-lateral dark dorsal surface.
